# Upstream repositories

Keep third-party checkouts outside the tracked repository (for example, in a user-selected `external/` directory ignored by Git). Do not copy full upstream projects into this repository. Record source URL, pinned commit/tag, license, install command, and local patch hashes in `docs/experiments/upstream-sources.md`.

Planned sources:

- [GigaWorld-Policy](https://github.com/open-gigaai/giga-world-policy)
- [RoboTwin 2.0](https://github.com/RoboTwin-Platform/RoboTwin)
- [wam.cpp](https://github.com/GigaAI-research/wam.cpp)

Their availability, checked-out revisions, and compatibility with this experiment are not yet revalidated in this local project.
